name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Amerec is considered to be one of the largest indoor sauna and steam bath manufacturers in the world, but nevertheless – their main objective is the top quality of their products, high performance standards and the ecological impact their manufacture leaves on the planet.



Customization of saunas and steam baths is one of the features Amerec offers in making each sauna and steam bath unit for indoor and commercial use. With the use of modern technologies Amerec creates luxurious sauna units to suit the most refined taste of any customer. Each infrared sauna is made specifically for the particular space the customer will install the sauna inThus Amerec infrared saunas are convenient, size-efficient and more luxurious than that f a traditional sauna.



A physically and mentally refreshing infrared sauna session defines the perfect personal retreat that anyone is looking for every day to shake away the stresses and tiredness of life. Relaxation, comfort, stress relief and so much more can be gained from using Amerec infrared saunas, made from the finest high quality materials available.
